description: This file defines classes related to inter-process communication (IPC) channels, including client and server types, with support for factory creation, connection management, and message invocation within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: IPCChannelClientType
classes.description: Template class representing an IPC client channel, supporting connection management, factory creation, and state changes.

classes.name: IPCChannelServerType
classes.description: Template class representing an IPC server channel, managing multiple client connections, registration of handlers, and message invocation.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the IPC channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the IPC channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the IPC channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the IPC channel is closed.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for a specified element type with an initial size.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Destroys the factory for a specified element type.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a command on the IPC channel with a wait time.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up client connections and resources.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts a new incoming client connection.

methods.name: CallRecursive
methods.description: Recursively calls clients to invoke a command.
